Messages.Author: hollowboy
Messages.Body:
Monique is empty. Monique has a mandatory hunt action.
Is there anything in the rules that specifies it has to be a cardless hunt action?
i.e. can she hunt with Loki's Gift?

"Hunt, and put this card on this vampire. This vampire can burn this card and 1 blood to get +1 stealth. A vampire can have only one Loki's Gift."

I fetch Gunther via Chain of Command, so he has a mandatory bleed action.
Is there anything in the rules that specifies it has to be a cardless bleed action?
i.e. can he play Deep Song to perform the bleed?

I play Lunatic Eruption on my own Jimmy Dunn, so entering combat with my prey as a D action is mandatory.
Is there anything in the rules that specifies it has to be a cardless enter combat action?
i.e. if I draw a Games of Instinct, can Jimmy rush my prey with it?
i.e. if my prey's Arika has a Haven Uncovered on her, can Jimmy use that?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> hollowboy wrote:
> Monique is empty. Monique has a mandatory hunt action.
> Is there anything in the rules that specifies it has to be a cardless hunt action?
>
No.
Rulebook: "Note that hunting is a mandatory action for a ready unlocked vampire with no blood."

> hollowboy wrote:
> i.e. can she hunt with Loki's Gift?
>
Yes.

> hollowboy wrote:
> I fetch Gunther via Chain of Command, so he has a mandatory bleed action.
> Is there anything in the rules that specifies it has to be a cardless bleed action?
>
No.
Chain of Command: "Those vampires must bleed."

> hollowboy wrote:
> i.e. can he play Deep Song to perform the bleed?
>
Yes.

> hollowboy wrote:
> I play Lunatic Eruption on my own Jimmy Dunn, so entering combat with my prey as a D action is mandatory.
> Is there anything in the rules that specifies it has to be a cardless enter combat action?
>
The action is provided by Lunatic Eruption. This specific action is mandatory. (and there's no such thing as a cardless enter combat action, except for Red List).
Lunatic Eruption: "During their minion phase, the attached minion must enter combat with a minion controlled by their prey as a  action"

> i.e. if I draw a Games of Instinct, can Jimmy rush my prey with it?
>
No.
>
> i.e. if my prey's Arika has a Haven Uncovered on her, can Jimmy use that?
>
No.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: cordovader
Messages.Body: Fun fact: a vampire with 2 Lunatic Eruption cannot act since he’s struck.
